messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired — HIGH 5xx rate on embeddings-prod (eu-west-1). Service: embeddings. Trigger: 5xx rate > 10% for 2m. PagerDuty incident: PD123456
alice: Oncall here, picking this up. Looking at dashboards.
ben: thx alice. I'm on standby, I can take if you want to hand off.
alice: quick check: client error? Looks like upstream inference returning 502s. Nginx shows spike from host pool eg-emb-03.
incident-bot: Alert details: Recent logs: 502 gateway, increased latency. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-502
carla: Customer ops: getting support tickets from PartnerX, 20% of calls failing. Raising customer impact.
alice: Ok failing requests routed to our dedicated eu pool. Rolling a sticky restart on eg-emb-03 now.
ben: +1 manual restart first. If that fails, we can drain and evacuate.
alice: /run restart-host eg-emb-03
incident-bot: Command queued: restart-host eg-emb-03 (initiated by alice)
ben: restart returned ok, but traffic still errors. KV cache mismatch in logs referencing shard-9.
dmitri: I'm seeing OOMs on eg-emb-03 before restart, kernel oom_killer reclaimed process 'tensor-server'. Could be memory leak in recent model rollout.
alice: timeline: 00:00 PD page, 00:30 restart, 00:45 errors persist. Going to redirect traffic off eg-emb pool to backup eu-warm while we investigate.
carla: Notifying PartnerX and CSM; ETA for mitigation?
alice: shifting traffic now. /run reroute traffic embeddings-prod -> eu-warm-pool
incident-bot: Reroute initiated by alice. New route will take ~20s.
ben: metrics showing 5xx back to baseline. Confirming customer requests success rate +98% on sample.
carla: PartnerX says errors stopped. Sending update to customers: "We're seeing failures earlier; we've rerouted traffic and are monitoring. More updates in 15m."
alice: Good. Remaining action: rollback recent model build 1.4.2 on eg-emb hosts, tag for hotter investigation. Ben can you own the rollback and postmortem?
ben: I’ll take rollback and postmortem. Will submit incident ticket PD-123456 and link to postmortem doc.
dmitri: I'll snapshot logs + heap profiles from eg-emb-03 for analysis.
carla: Thanks — I'll coordinate customer comms and CSM handoff.
alice: handoff to ben at 00:58 UTC. If anything may re-escalate, ping with @here.
ben: ack — taking ownership. will ping status in 10m with rollback progress.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by ben (oncall). Incident assigned: ben. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456
ben: status: rollback started (rolling back model to 1.4.1 across eg-emb pool). ETA 12m.
carla: customer update sent.
ben: rollback completed, validating traffic. 5xx rate stable at baseline for 5m.
alice: closing initial PD page; handover complete. ben owns postmortem.
ben: will draft postmortem and link runbook updates.
carla: closing loop with PartnerX after final PM.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by ben. PD status: Resolved. Duration: 00:12
alice: great work team :clap:
ben: thanks all :thumbsup:
